title: FPS Basepack
description: A Basepack with mods for optimization and small qol-mods split into server and client side, that makes creating modpacks for personal use easier without having all the basic mods in the same list as your content mods.
body:
This is a small basepack with the idea of adding content mods onto this modpack.

It already includes some mods that add to the vanilla experience like Enchantment Infuser, Trade Cycling, HT's TreeChop, Lootr and other small mods, enhancing the vanilla experience to a certain degree.
